'''Kal'Shebbol's Fury''' was a [[special missions platoon]] serving with the [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] during his campaign as a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]. The unit was led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gerrin Nikals]]. The platoon consisted of two [[sharpshooter squad]]s, one [[engineering squad]], and one [[heavy weapons squad]].
